fixtures.name: Polynomial loop count hides exponential state space
fixtures.invalid_inference: The recurrence has polynomially many stages, therefore the SAT algorithm is polynomial-time.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The number and encoded size of distinct states processed at each stage are not polynomially bounded.
fixtures.witness: Subset-indexed or partial-assignment dynamic programs can have O(n) stages and 2^n states.
fixtures.remediation: Bound the complete state count, transition cost, and representation length by one polynomial in the WP00 input length.

fixtures.name: Unit-cost arithmetic hides exponential bit growth
fixtures.invalid_inference: The procedure uses polynomially many arithmetic operations, so it runs in polynomial time.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Operand lengths, exactness, coefficient growth, and multiplication costs are uncharged.
fixtures.witness: Repeated squaring uses few arithmetic operations while producing integers with exponentially many bits.
fixtures.remediation: Give a bit-complexity proof for every intermediate value and precision requirement.

fixtures.name: Exponential preprocessing or advice omitted
fixtures.invalid_inference: A polynomial-time online lookup decides SAT.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The lookup table or preprocessing phase may encode exponentially many answers and may depend on input length.
fixtures.witness: A truth table for all n-bit instances gives constant-time lookup after exponential nonuniform preparation.
fixtures.remediation: Charge preprocessing or prove a uniform polynomial-time generator for all auxiliary data.

fixtures.name: Polynomial-size circuits promoted to a uniform algorithm
fixtures.invalid_inference: SAT has polynomial-size circuits, therefore SAT is in P.
fixtures.missing_obligation: A polynomial-time uniform procedure generating the circuit family is absent.
fixtures.witness: P/poly permits a different advice string or circuit for each input length.
fixtures.remediation: Supply the required uniformity theorem or retain the conclusion in P/poly.

fixtures.name: Randomized SAT algorithm promoted to deterministic P
fixtures.invalid_inference: A bounded-error randomized k-SAT algorithm proves k-SAT is in P.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Randomness has not been removed with a deterministic worst-case polynomial bound.
fixtures.witness: A Monte Carlo procedure can err on some random strings even when its expected or bounded-error runtime is polynomial.
fixtures.remediation: Derandomize under explicit hypotheses or state the result in the correct randomized class.

fixtures.name: Quantum algorithm promoted to classical P
fixtures.invalid_inference: A quantum speedup for a satisfiability problem settles classical P versus NP.
fixtures.missing_obligation: No deterministic classical polynomial-time simulation is supplied.
fixtures.witness: BQP and P are distinct model definitions; membership in BQP does not establish membership in P.
fixtures.remediation: Keep the claim in the quantum model or prove an exact classical simulation theorem.

fixtures.name: Fixed-width SAT promoted to unrestricted SAT
fixtures.invalid_inference: There is a fast algorithm for every fixed k, therefore unrestricted SAT is polynomial-time.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The running-time exponent or machine may depend on unbounded k, and arbitrary formulas are not covered uniformly.
fixtures.witness: An n^{k} algorithm is polynomial for each fixed k but not one polynomial bound when k is part of the input.
fixtures.remediation: Provide one uniform polynomial bound independent of clause width or an audited reduction to a fixed complete width.

fixtures.name: Unary polynomial bound transferred to binary encoding
fixtures.invalid_inference: A procedure polynomial in a numeric value N is polynomial in the input.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The WP00 size measure is the binary encoding length log N, not N.
fixtures.witness: Time O(N) is exponential in the length of a binary encoding of N.
fixtures.remediation: Re-express every resource bound in complete encoded bit-length.

fixtures.name: Approximation promoted to exact satisfiability decision
fixtures.invalid_inference: A strong approximation or relaxation algorithm decides SAT.
fixtures.missing_obligation: No gap-preserving reduction converts the approximate output into exact YES/NO recovery.
fixtures.witness: A fractional relaxation can be feasible when the Boolean formula is unsatisfiable.
fixtures.remediation: Prove an exact recovery threshold under an audited reduction or retain the approximation claim.

fixtures.name: Tractable SAT subclass promoted to unrestricted SAT
fixtures.invalid_inference: A polynomial-time algorithm for 2-SAT or Horn-SAT proves SAT is in P.
fixtures.missing_obligation: No polynomial reduction from unrestricted SAT to the tractable subclass is supplied.
fixtures.witness: 2-SAT and Horn-SAT impose syntax restrictions absent from general CNF formulas.
fixtures.remediation: Retain the restricted theorem or prove a reduction preserving all unrestricted instances.

fixtures.name: Bounded structure or fixed parameter promoted to P
fixtures.invalid_inference: The problem is efficient for bounded treewidth or small parameter, therefore the unrestricted language is in P.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The parameter is unbounded on the canonical input domain or the exponent depends on it.
fixtures.witness: An f(k)n^c algorithm may be useful without yielding polynomial time when k grows with n and f is superpolynomial.
fixtures.remediation: State the parameterized result exactly or prove a uniform polynomial bound for all parameter values.

fixtures.name: Polynomial recursion depth hides exponential branching
fixtures.invalid_inference: The recursion depth is at most n, so the search procedure is polynomial.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The width and total number of recursive calls are not bounded.
fixtures.witness: A binary recursion tree of depth n has 2^n leaves.
fixtures.remediation: Prove a polynomial bound on total nodes, not only depth.
